{
  "jobspec": "#!/bin/bash
##Kør på gpu
#FLUX: --queue=gpuv100
##Antal gpuer vi vil bruge. Kommenter ud hvis cpu.
#FLUX: --gpus=1
#FLUX: --exclusive

##Navn på job
#FLUX: --job-name=NN_03-01
##Output fil
#FLUX: --output=output/NN_03-01-%j.out
##Antal kerner
#FLUX: --ntasks=5
##Hvor lang tid må den køre hh:mm
#FLUX: --time=20:00:00

# The LSF directive '-R "rusage[mem=6GB]"' does not have a direct equivalent in Flux and has been omitted.
# The performance implication is that the job may be scheduled on a node without enough memory, potentially causing it to fail.

# The LSF directives for email notification (-B, -N) have no direct equivalent in Flux and have been omitted.
# Omission of these directives means the user will not receive email notifications about job status changes.


module purge
#module load tensorflow/1.5-cpu-python-3.6.2
module load tensorflow/1.5-gpu-python-3.6.2


for drop in 0.2 0.25 0.3 0.4
do
	for N in 250 350 400 450 550
	do
		for nhidden in 6
		do
			for act in sigmoid
			do
				for folder in '03-01-2019 11.04' '09-01-2019 12.57' '11-10-2018 11.36'
				do
					for func in group_period_x_group_period group_period_2x2 atomic_number
					do
						python3 NN/NN_script.py $drop $N sigmoid 6 "$folder" $func
					done
				done
			done
		done
	done
done
"
}
